'''José Constantino Nalda García''' (born 5 August 1939) is a Spanish politician and member of the [[Spanish Socialist Workers' Party]] (PSOE) who served as [[President of the Junta of Castile and León]] from November 1986 to July 1987.<ref>{{cite news |date=2 November 1986 |title=Seis de los ocho consejeros de Castilla y León se oponen al nombramiento de Nalda |url=https://elpais.com/diario/1986/11/02/espana/531270009_850215.html |work=El País |accessdate=11 December 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |date=4 November 1986 |title=José Nalda, candidato socialista para sustituir a Demetrio Madrid |url=https://elpais.com/diario/1986/11/04/espana/531442820_850215.html |work=El País |accessdate=11 December 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |date=5 November 1986 |title=José Nalda inicia contactos para formar Gobierno en Castilla y León |url=https://elpais.com/diario/1986/11/05/espana/531529216_850215.html |work=El País |accessdate=11 December 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |date=15 November 1986 |title=Nalda, elegido presidente de la Junta de Castilla y León por mayoría absoluta |url=https://elpais.com/diario/1986/11/15/espana/532393227_850215.html |work=El País |accessdate=11 December 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |date=28 May 1987 |url=https://elpais.com/diario/1987/05/28/espana/549151223_850215.html |title=Tres presidentes socialistas en nueve meses, si vence el PSOE |language=Spanish |newspaper=El País |accessdate=11 December 2019}}</ref>
